sourceQuote: Applicants holding an HSK Level 4 certificate (for Chinese Language – Business Track: HSK 4 score 180 or above; for Chinese Language – International Chinese Education Track: HSK 4 score 210 or above, and HSKK Intermediate 60 or above) are exempt from the Chinese language (Humanities Chinese)subject in the CSCA test.
targetQuote: 持有HSK级4证书的申请人（中文专业—商务方向：HSK 4成绩180或以上；中文专业—国际中文教育方向：HSK 4成绩210或以上，以及HSKK中级60或以上）可免考CSCA考试中的中文（人文中文）科目。
